name: Sodium myreth sulfate
description: Sodium myreth sulfate (CAS 25446-80-4 ), commercially available as UNIPOL ES-40 and TEXAPON K 14S SPEZ, is an ethoxylated anionic surfactant derived from myristic acid. It delivers effective foaming, cleansing, and emulsification performance across personal care and industrial cleaning formulations. In shampoos, body washes, and facial cleansers, it functions as a primary surfactant, generating dense, stable foam while maintaining a mild skin profile suitable for rinse-off products. Liquid hand soaps and baby care formulations incorporate it where a gentler alternative to standard sulfates is required without sacrificing lather quality. This makes it a versatile choice for sensitive skin applications. In home care products such as dishwashing liquids and surface cleaners, it contributes to grease emulsification and soil removal at moderate use levels. It remains stable across various pH ranges in these settings. Industrial and institutional cleaning concentrates also utilize it for its compatibility with other anionic and amphoteric surfactants in high-active systems. This synergy allows for the creation of powerful degreasing agents. Sodium myreth sulfate is typically supplied as a clear to slightly hazy aqueous liquid or paste, with active matter concentrations commonly ranging from 25% to 70%. It is available in cosmetic-grade specifications meeting the requirements of major personal care regulatory frameworks. Bulk supply is standard in drums and IBC containers for global distribution. Grades are suited for both personal care and industrial cleaning end uses, ensuring high performance and reliability. The material is handled according to standard chemical safety protocols.
